transcript: So I'm a really big fan of MCC Theater Company. They are Off Broadway theater company, and they just announced what might be one of the best off Broadway seasons I've ever seen. It's going to feature 3 new musicals, one of which is a new Jason Robert Brown musical like hello, let that again. New Jason Rob Brown. Amazing. The second is Gavin krill's one man show about his trip to the met. It's a musical that he wrote. He's gonna star in it. I love Gavin Krill. I'll see anything he does. I can't wait for this one. And then, as if those 2 weren't enough, they are also doing the East Coast premiere of The Lonely Few, which just had its world premiere at the Geffen Playhouse in LA earlier this year. I'm super excited. It's described as a honky tonk lesbian romance, and the cast is absolutely stacked. We have Lauren Patton, we have Sierra Renee, we have Damon Dano. It's amazing. It is probably my most anticipated show of the season. I cannot wait for any of these.
